en.hubeali:
From him, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The supplication is more piercing than the spear-heads of the iron’.
en.sarwar: 7. It is narrated from him (narrator of the Hadith above) from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
Prayer, pleading before Allah for help, is more effective than spears of iron.’”
